notes: Reconciliation: τοῦ in περὶ τοῦ Μωϋσέως σώματος is the determiner of the whole noun phrase, not an article before a name — MACULA's structured parse reads it as neuter, agreeing with σώματος, and the legacy T-GSM string is a known tagging artifact. Aligned it to “the” and left σώματος bare, matching JUD.1.4 (τὴν τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν χάριτα → “the grace of our God”) and the corpus treatment of an article separated from its head noun by an interposed genitive.
